remarks:
We are pleased to present a scenic and level lot,  offering the combination of tillable acres and a wooded portion for deer hunting or recreation. A quiet setting with mature conifer trees provide habitat for deer and an elevated driveway is established from a gas well easement providing a residential driveway opportunity. A small pond is located in the SW corner of the field. Ideally located between Eden, Evans, North Collins, and Angola, this parcel delivers the perfect blend of privacy and convenience.

This setting is perfectly suited for constructing your dream home while enjoying the peace, quiet, and natural beauty of a rural landscape.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Timber and GMO rights convey,   2.5 miles to Eden, 4.1 miles to Angola, 7.4 miles to North Collins, 7.3 miles to Hamburg. Taxes TBD post subdivision, subdivision based on town approval.
Buyer agent must be present on all showings. Do not send clients out without accompanying them.
